seednet_fields.Parentage: (CSV 20 x Pant Chari 5) x (CSV 20 x PVK 809)- 11-1-1-2-1-1  CSV 20 = SPV 246 x Kh-89-246- Dual sorghum variety Pant Chari 5 = CS 3541 x IS 6935 – Forage sorghum variety PVK 809 = PVK 801 x SPV 881 – Dual sorghum variety
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Rainfed Kharif; Zone-II (Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka)
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Suitable for timely sowing (June 15 to July 15 sowing) SPV 2316 showed good response to increasing doses of fertility levels and gave an average gain of 6.8% and 5.7% for green and dry fodder yield respectively at higher dose (125% of RDF) (1010:50:50 kg NPK/ha) of fertilizers. The variety also performed better than CSV 30F Resistant to lodging and seed shattering (visual evaluation) Seed rate: 20-25 kg/ha
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: 1.	Leaf mid-rib colour: Yellow green and dropping leaves 2.	Days to 50% flowering: 70-72 days 3.	Panicle: Semi-compact and well exserted 4.	Panicle: Arista present (Awned apikelet) 5.	Seed size and colour: Medium bold and yellow white. 6.	Seed shape: Elliptic
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Adopted top rainfed Kharif and resistant to leaf.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: SPV 2316 recorded high resistance for grey leaf spot (2.35), shooty stripe (1.0), L:eaf blight (2.63) and Rust (1.30) and moderately resistant to Zonate Leaf spot (4.97), Anthracnose (3.30) and Grain mould (3.50) under natural field conditions on disease scale of 1-10.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: SPV 2316 is tolerant to stem borer (Average Dead heart score=14.83) and Shootly pest (average dead heart score = 34.6) and on par with the checks CSV 21F and CSV30F under natural field conditions.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Nitrogen 80-100 kg/ha in two split doses (half at the time of sowing as basal and half at 35-40 days after sowing or at knee stage of the crop. Application of phosphorus (P) 40-50 kg/ha and potash (K)

seednet_fields.Parentage:
It is developed from a cross between widely adopted annigeri variety and ICC 4958.
The cross was made at ICRISAT for incorporating good rooting traits of ICC 4958 into widely adopted Annigeri variety and the advance breeding lines were sent to RARS, Nandral.  Promising selection was identified at RARS, Nandyal for high yield with bold and attractive seeds.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Rabi season and in all chickpea growing districts of Andhra Pradesh.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: NBeG 49 has not responded to application of higher doses of N. Recommended fertilizers are 20 kg N and 50 kg P2Os per ha.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Semi spreading and medium in height, green stem with anthocyanin pigmentation on the stem, pink flowers with medium sized leaf lets and pods.  Seeds medium bold, angular, brown colour seeds with rough testa with uniform size.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Performs well compared to JG11 under receding moisture conditions.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: At RARS, Nandyal during 2013-14 to 2015 16, NBeG 49 is found be on par with resistant check JG 315 with respect to its reaction to Fusarium wilt and dry root rot. In All India Coordinated trials (AVT I of 2011-12), it recorded resistant reaction to Fusarium wilt in one location and moderately resistant reaction in one location out of 14 locations tested. It also recorded resistant reaction to collar rot, in one location out of 5 locations tested.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: NBeG 49 is on par with tolerant check ICCL 86111 in its reaction to Helicoverpa.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): 20 kg N and 50 kg P per ha. (50 kg urea and 300 kg SSP or 125 kg DAP at the final preparation of field).

seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: TOLERANT TO MOISTURE STRESS
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: MOST SERIOUS DISEASES IN NORTH-WESTERN AND SOUTHERN PARTS OF INDIA IS YELLOW MOSAIC VIRUS (YMV). IN CO-ORDINATED PATHOLOGY TRIALS, THE YMV INFECTION IN V-20 AS WELL AS IN THE SHECKS ( C-152 & V-16) WAS SIMILAR AT COIMBATORE. THE PERCENTAGE OF INFECTION IN V-240 RANGES BETWEEEN 3.7- 20.8% WHEREAS C-152 THE ESTABLISHED YMV RESISTANT VARIETY, HAD INFECTION IN THE RANGE OF 6.6-19.0. V-240 HAS SHOWN COMPLETE RESISTANCE TO YMV IN CENTRAL PART OF INDIA. THE PROPOSED VARIETY ASLO DISPLAY BETTER RESISTANCE TO BACTERIAL BLIGHT IS COMPARED TO THE CHEEKS AT ALL THE LOCATIONS EXCEPT DURGAPURA, WHICH WAS AT PAR. V-240 HAS ALSO SHOWN A GREATER RESISTANCE TO TIP BLIGHT, ANTHROCNOSE AND MACROPHOMIA BLIGHT AS COMPARED TO THE CHECKS.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: IN THE ENTOMOLOGICAL TRIALS CONDUCTED DURING 1982-83, THE SEED DAMAGE CAUSED BY THE POD BORER IN V-240 WAS SLIGHTLY LESS (1.2-5%) THAN IN C-152 (1.7-6.5%) AND V-16 (1.0-8.2%)

seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: a. Plant height: 110-120 cm; b. Distinguishing Morphological characteristics: Creamish white seed with 3/4th brownish margin around hilum and moderately resistant to CYMV.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Cowpea has relatively higher drought tolerance than other legume crops.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: The proposed variety HC 98-46 (Hisar COpea-46) has exhibited moderate resistance against all the four major diseases including CYMV.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: The proposed variety HC 98-46 has been found consistently least susceptible to both leafhopper and white fly. No bruchid infestation was observed in the field conditions in this genotype.

seednet_fields.Parentage: VL 7 HAS BEEN DERIVED FROM A CROSS BETWEEN TWO RELEASED GARDEN PEA VARIETY viz., PANT UPHAR (IP 3) AND ARKEL. SELECTION FOR YIELD, EARLINESS AND OTHER DESIRABLE CHARACTERS WAS FOLLOWED IN THE SEGREGATING GENERATIONS AND F6 WAS BULKED DURING 1983 FOR EVALUATION.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: RECOMMENDED FOR RLEASE AND CULTIVATION IN ZONE IV SUBJECT TO THA CONDITION THAT THE ZONE IV STATES NAME ARE TO BE INFORMED PROJECT  CO-ORDINATOR FOR GARDEN PEAS BEFORE NOTIFICATION. IRRIGATED CONDITIONS DURING RABI IN ZONE-IV AND ZONE-I
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: THE AGRONOMICAL TRIALS RELATED TO FERTILIZER RESPONSE, SOWING TIME, SPACING AND SEED RATES WERE CONDUCTED DURING 1992-93 AT ALMORA FOR COMPARING VL 7 WITH ARKEL. THE VARIETY VL 7 WAS FOUND TO BE SIGNIFICANTLY SUPERIOR THAN ARKEL AS IT PRODUCED 15.3% HIGHER GREEN POD YIELD. VL.7 RESPONDED VERY WELL TO FYM APPLICATION AND CHEMICAL FERTILIZERS. APPLICATION OF 20 KG N 60 KG P2O5 AND 40 KG K2 O PER HECTARE ALONGWITH 20T/HA FYM WAS FOUND TO BE THE OPTIMUM DOSE WHICH PRODUCED 177.0 Q/HA GREEN POD YIELD.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: PLANT HEIGHT : 65-70 CM PLANTS ARE DWARF WITH DETEMINATE GROWTH HABIT, DARK GREEN FOLIAGE, WHITE FLOWERS AND TWO PODS PER PEDUNCLE. IT CAN BE EASILY DISTINGUISHED FROM THE ARKEL BY ITS EXTREMELY FASTER GROWTH AND LIGHT FOLIAGE COLOUR AT EARLY VEGETATIVE PHASE. THE PODS ARE LIGHT GREEN SLIGHTLY IN CURCED TO WARDS SUTURE AT THE DISTAL END. MEDIUM IN SIZE ( 8CM) WITH COMPLETE FILLING. THE PODS COMTAIN 6-7 SEED/POD WITH 42% SHELLING GREEN GRAINS ARE BLOD (41.2 G/100, GRAIN) AND DIMPLED. SEED IN LIGHT GREEN, WRINKLED WITH 1000 SEED wt.OF 220-225 GMS.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: THE INCIDENCE OF POWDERY MILDEW AND WHITE ROT DISEASE IS SIMILAR TO ARKEL UNDER NATURAL CONDITIONS. HOWEVER, IT SHOWED LESS INCIDENCE OF ALTERNARIA BLIGHT THAN ARKEL. THE INCIDENCE OF LEAF MINOR AND POD BORER HAS BEEN OBSERVED TO BE SIMILAR TO RELEASED VARIETIES.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: THE INCIDENCE OF POWDERY MILDEW AND WHITE ROT

seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: DATA OF AGRONOMIC TRIALS CONDUCTED AT RAU, DHOLI DURING 1986-92 CLEARLY INDICATED THE SUPERIORITY OF PUSA9 OVER ALL OTHER VARIETIES INCLUDING THE CHECK BOTH UNDER KHARIF AND PRE-RABI SOWINGS. PUSA 9 RANKED FIRST DURING ALL THE THREE YEARS OF TESTING UNDER SEPTEMBER SOWINGS AND RECORDED AS HIGH AS 50% INCREASED YIELD OVER THE CHECK DA 11 (SHARAD). THOUGH SPACING EFFECTS WERE NOT SIGNIFICANT UNDER NORMAL SOWING PUSA 9 ISPARTICULARLY SUITED TO CLOSER PLANTING DUE TO ITS ERECT AND COMPACT GROWTH HABIT. THE DETALILED MORPHOLOGICAL FEATURES OF PUSA 9 A EVALUATED UNDER PUSA ENVIRONMENT ARE.  KHARIF - DAYS TO 50% FLOWERING 180 DAYS  PRE- RABI - 160 DAYS DAYS TO MATURITY KHARIF 260 DAYS PRE- RABI 210 DAYS
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: PLANT HEIGHT : (I) WEIGHTED MEAN : NORMAL- 220, PRE-RABI -155 (II) RANGE OVER LOCATIONS : NORMAL-210-335, PRE-RABI- 130-160 (I) GROWTH HABIT : TALL, ERECT, COMPACT INDETERMINATE (II) LEAF CHARACTERS : TRIFOLIATE COMPOUND, SHAPE OF LEAF PINNA : LANCEOLATE, ACUTE ENTIRE, UPPER SURFACE SMOOTH, COLOUR: DARK GREEN, PUBESCENT/GLABROUS :  PUBESCENT, WAXY/NON-WAXY : WAXY  (II) STEM COLOUR : GREEN (IV) FLOWER STRUCTURE : PAPILIONACEOUS FLOWER, STANTARD HAVING LIGHT PURPLE STREAKS, WINGS YELLOW AND KEEL CREAM COLOURED., (V) PODS UNRIPE PODS GREEN WITH PURPLE STREAKS; AVERAGE SEED PER POD 4.0 BROWN, GOLD, OBLONG WITH 10.5 GM/100 SEEDS
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: WILT, STERILITY MOSAIC AND ALTERNARIA LEAF BLIGHT ARE THE MAJOR DISEASES IN THE NEP ZONE, PUSA 9 IS AT PER WITH THE CHECK VARIETY BAHAR FOR ITS REACTION TO WILT, TOLERANT TO SMV UNDER NORMAL KHARIF BUT ESCAPES ALTOGETHER WHEN PLANTED DURING PRE- RABI (SEPTEMBER). PUSA 9 EXCELS BAHAR CHECK IN ALTERNARIA LEAF BLIGHT RESISTANCE.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: BECAUSE OF THE POLYPHAGOUS NATURE OF PESTS, NONE OF THE VARIETIES ARE RESISTANT TO POD BORER AND  POD FLY. HOWEVER, PUSA 9 IS AT PAR WITH THE CHECK VARIETY FOR RESISTANCE AGAINST BOTH THE PESTS.

seednet_fields.Parentage: Girnar 1 x ICGS 11
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Recommended for release and cultivation in the States of West Bengal, Orissa and Manipur under Kharif rainfed condition. Early maturity - 108 days. Average Yield - 15.20 Qtl./ha.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: The proposed variety responded well to the higher than recommended doses of phosphatic fertilizers i.e. Girnar 3 (PBS 12160) gave a pod yield of 1560 Kg/ha at 90 Kg P2O5 compared to 60 Kg.ha of P2O5 was 14%.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: - Leaflet size: Small; - Leaflet shape: Elliptic; - Leaflet colour: Green; - Flowering pattern on side branches: Sequential; - Flowering on main stem: Absent; - Inflorescence: Multiple; Kernel size : small; testa colour : rose; 100-seed mass : 34 (31 to 37) g; oil content (%) : 45 (42 to 49); sound mature kernels (%) : 84 (78 to 92).
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: a) Plant height: 17-22 cm; b) DIstinguishing morphological Characters: - Growth habit: Intermediate: semi-erect to erect, decumbent-3; - Branching pattern: Irregular: without flowers on mains tem; but with flowering on n+1, n+2 branches
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Girnar 3 (PBS 12160) has low specific leaf area and high chlorophyll meter reading (SCMR) and these attributes onfer water use efficiency.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: The proposed variety was comparable with both the check and qualifying varieties for the incidences rust and late leaf spot.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: For thrips, the vector of PBND, the proposed variety, Girnar 3 (PBS 12160), has shown a lower incidence (12.8%) then that shown by national check, JL-24 (18.3%).

ARRANGEMENT ON STEM ALTERNATE; SEEDS : WHITE WITH 46.6% OIL, 1000 SEED WEIGHT - 2.9 GM.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: MACROPHOMINA STEM/ROOT ROT: THE PROPOSED VARIETY HAS GIVEN MODERATELY RESISTANT REACTION TO MACROPHOMINA STEMROOT ON AN AVERAGE TESTED IN SICK PLOT. THE VARIETY HAS SHOWN MINIMUM INCIDENCE TO THE DISEASE AS COMPARED TO ALMOST ALL THE CHECKS AND VARIETIES.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: CAPSULE BORER: THE PROPOSED VARIETY HAS GIVEN COMPARABLE RESISTANCE WITH THE NATIONAL CHECK TC-25 AND ZONAL CHECK RT-46.
